Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be referred to as the claimant for this, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, heading straight through on a green light.
Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?
A: A vehicle coming from my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. I saw it only a split second
before impact, so I couldn't brake in time.
Q: Did you have any chance to avoid the other car?
A: No. It came across faster than I expected, and by the time I registered it, we had already collided.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes, my neck. I felt a sharp jolt and then stiffness right away. I've been dealing with soreness at the base of my
neck and some tightness across my shoulders since then.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I was checked at an urgent care clinic the same day. They looked at my neck, gave me a prescription for pain
relief, and recommended a follow-up with my regular doctor.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, the stiffness is better in the mornings but worsens after I've been sitting at my desk for a while. Turning my
head to the left is still uncomfortable.
Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?
A: There was a pedestrian at the corner who I think saw the light change, but I don't have their contact information.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow my treatment plan, and I want my vehicle damage and medical costs taken
care of properly.
</page>
